timing: One-step prediction before round3..20 using strictly prior own/peer contributions and publicly announced rules. Earlier confirmation responses are permitted causal online history, never fitted parameters. Surveys and session2 excluded.
grouping: Complete first-session interacting pair;20% hash heldout in each treatment; remaining groups in5 deterministic whole-pair folds. Both players remain together.
primary_metric: MAE averaged within group, then equally across groups
calibration: One-step prediction before round3..20 using strictly prior own/peer contributions and publicly announced rules. Earlier confirmation responses are permitted causal online history, never fitted parameters. Surveys and session2 excluded.
selection: Smallest development group-balanced OOF MAE among baseline/candidate families; within1% choose lower parameter count. Confirmation never selects reference.
continuation: At least5 material hypotheses, continue justified distinct hypotheses until2 consecutive after minimum5 show no improvement of >1% in prediction or explicit robustness/interpretation. No retuning after confirmation.
uncertainty: No row bootstrap; enumerate group errors and leave-group development variability. Single heldout condition is bounded evidence.
exposure_audit: Schema inspection exposed first two full-equality pairs and their duplicate records. Exact overlap with hash confirmation recorded; no aggregate confirmation metrics before freeze.
